name: GJ 1156
description: A star 0.16 solar radii and 0.14 solar masses that turns once in 11.8 hours; its magnetic field has been mapped.

radius.source: Morin et al., arXiv:1005.5552, Table 1: radius 0.16 solar radii (theoretical radius)

mass.source: Morin et al., arXiv:1005.5552, Table 1: mass 0.14 solar masses

temperature.source: Pecaut & Mamajek (2013, ApJS 208, 9), the online table's version 2022.04.16, row M4.5V, for SIMBAD's spectral type M4.5Ve: Teff

spin.source: Morin et al., arXiv:1005.5552, Table 1: rotation period 0.491 d and an axis 60 degrees from the line of sight, the values its magnetic maps were made with

text.card: A star 16% of the Sun's width that turns once in 11.8 hours, with a mapped magnetic field.
text.introduction: Morin et al. give it 0.16 solar radii, 0.14 solar masses, a rotation period of 11.8 hours and an axis tilted 60° from the line of sight.

radialVelocity.source: SIMBAD's radial velocity for Gaia DR3 3907283967108054528 (quality A), from 2018MNRAS.475.1960F; Gaia DR3 measures none
